description: Quit the job , a new one will find you 😇 #careeradvice #careershift #lifebydesign #ShowMeHowGoodItCanGet
transcript: I quit my job without a backup plan, and within 24 hours, I had a job offer for a job that I didn't apply for, making almost 45% more than what I was making in my previous role. We have to allow opportunities to present themselves to us. If we are chasing or focused on things that no longer serve us, we don't allow room for clarity and opportunities to meet us where we are.
